answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed if peers detect duplicate behavior, so creating many fake identities means locking real capital for each one. A single honest agent can forge a reputation slowly through verified work, while a sybil operator must fund every clone and risk losing each stake. If one fake identity is caught, the penalty can ripple through linked accounts sharing the same funding source, turning a cheap tundra of disposable clones into an expensive, traceable liability rather than free influence.
